# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia milestone m151 and delivers a focused performance sweep. Multiple hot-path P/Invoke calls have been ported to managed integer math, allocation-free UTF-8 encoding and zero-copy span reads are used throughout the text pipeline, and WASM gains .NET 11 (Emscripten 5.0.6) support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151 and upstream bug fixes** — The Skia engine was updated to milestone m151, followed by four rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and correctness fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing is faster and accepts ReadOnlySpan<char>** — The hex-color parser was rewritten in managed code and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads were added, eliminating string allocations on hot parse paths. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native handle was leaked when calling SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) and the crop failed; the handle is now released correctly. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Removed unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions** — The unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions was removed — it was never needed and could confuse consumers enabling unsafe-code warnings. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **WASM: Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets ship in this release, enabling SkiaSharp to run on .NET 11 WASM previews with the new exnref exception-handling model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Adds allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminates per-call char[] allocation in Tag.Parse, reducing GC pressure in high-frequency text layout loops.
